name: Agent Roster
description: Orca's Activity view in its own sidebar pane, with real session titles and shortcuts to cycle between agents.

screenshots.alt: The Agent Roster panel grouped by status, in a dark theme, listing seven sample agents with their session titles.
screenshots.caption: Every running agent grouped by status, with the real session title.

screenshots.alt: The Agent Roster panel grouped by worktree, in a light theme, with every agent of each worktree visible and one row highlighted as the shortcut cursor.
screenshots.caption: Group by worktree: nothing is folded away, and the highlighted row is where the shortcuts continue from.

settings.title: Group by
settings.description: How the Agent Roster panel groups agents: by status (like Orca's Activity view) or under their worktree.

settings.title: Shortcut order
settings.description: The order the next and previous shortcuts walk: the panel's status order, or worktree by worktree so repeated presses visit every agent of a worktree.

settings.title: Skip finished agents when cycling
settings.description: The shortcuts pass over agents that are done, idle, interrupted or failed.

settings.title: Show child agents
settings.description: Also show the finished sub-agents Orca folds away under their coordinator. Running sub-agents are always listed, as in the Activity view.
